<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/vendor/companies"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Lists every company that has turned on your partner key, ordered by name. This is the first call a partner makes, and the only one sent with your partner key and no `KISS-Company` header. Each company carries its `company_id`: send it as `KISS-Company` on every other request you make for that company. It also lists the locations you can reach (each with its `location_id`, your `external_location_code` and its address), whether the company enabled only some of its locations (`location_scoped`), its facility and lock-support phone numbers, and the name and email of each of its administrators. When a company enabled only some locations, `locations` lists just those and can be empty. A company that turns you off no longer appears. See the [partner keys guide](/guides/partner-keys).
